action.objective: Verify f1f2 as the safer of the two legal king moves and preserve king safety.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search already favors f1f2 (-365) over f1g1 (-598), with f1g1 line showing heavy material loss. f1f2 keeps the king off the rook's first-rank pressure and avoids the Qe2+ pin line that led to ruin. Verifying f1f2 at depth 4 with the reserved 2000 nodes to check for tactical refutation.
